general.title: General Settings
general.description: Configure your workspace options and details.

members.title: Member Management
members.removeDialogDescription: Remove {name} from this workspace? Removed members must re-enter the password to join again.

permissions.title: Member Permissions
permissions.description: Set the shared permissions applied to regular members. The owner always has full permissions.

canCreate.description: Can create folders and mock API items.

apiKey.title: API Key
apiKey.description: Used by external clients such as MCP to access this workspace. A key is issued automatically when the workspace is created; reissuing immediately invalidates the previous key.
apiKey.copyFailed: Failed to copy the API key.
apiKey.mcpHint: This key is automatically filled into the install config on the MCP integration page.
apiKey.reissueDialogDescription: Are you sure you want to reissue the API key? Reissuing will immediately invalidate the existing key, and all external services (MCP, etc.) using it will stop working.

install.title: Install MCP
install.description: Connect this workspace's mock API tools to an AI client (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.).
install.step1: Paste the config below into your client's .mcp.json. (The API key and workspace ID are already filled in.)
install.step2: Replace the --prefix value with your monorepo's absolute path.
install.note: The api app (port 4001) must be running.

usage.title: Usage
usage.description: After installation, ask the AI in natural language and the tools below are used automatically. All items are addressed by path (e.g. /shop/users).

codeOptions.title: Code generation options
codeOptions.description: When you ask for code, the AI asks these options (supported clients show a picker) or skips any you already specified.

create_mock_api.desc: Generate mock data from a schema, create a mock API, and return the URL
create_mock_api.example: Create a products mock API with id, name, price fields, 10 items.

list_mock_apis.desc: List folders and mock APIs by path
list_mock_apis.example: What's in this workspace right now?

delete_mock_api.desc: Delete an item by path (folders include children)

rename_mock_api.desc: Rename an item by path (URL path is recomputed)

update_mock_api.desc: Regenerate a mock API's schema and data by path (name/location kept)
update_mock_api.example: Add an email field to the products schema and update it.

get_api_code.example: Give me products integration code in ts, fetch+query, zod.
